g.text: Takeaway: one V-groove array aligns all fibres at once and stays steady, so it is well suited to automated testing and glued packaging.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: The price: I/Os must follow the array’s fixed pattern. Book Sec. 12.1.1 (pp. 384–385), Fig. 12.5; 127 µm pitch from Sec. 12.2. All drawings schematic.
